title: Galactic Bounce HIT → Flattened Impulse → Jump Rope World Sense

thesis.bounce: Information hops kingdoms / voxels until σ hits the inflection (the HIT).
thesis.HIT: 0.45 ≤ σ ≤ 0.55 — quiet turn neighborhood. Acceleration≈0, change fastest. The ball meets the floor.
thesis.flattened: At HIT the manifold flattens (decision boundary). What falls off is topology-already-known. The floor SENDS THE IMPULSE BACK up the rope.
thesis.jump_rope: World sense = cadence of HIT→impulse→HIT. Each slap of the rope is a proprioceptive tick: where we are in unsupervised space, what labels Salmon would assign, what reward the membrane RL loop just scored.
thesis.world_sense: Not a map from outside — rhythm from bounce: distance (cloaca), time (t-plane), identity intervals (HIIT).

unsupervised.name: HIIT — HIT Identity Interval Training
unsupervised.what: No labels. Cluster by how often / how far between HITs. Identity = interval signature of a kingdom/walker/bay.
unsupervised.interval: Δcycle or Δt between successive sigmoid HITs (or quiet-turn crossings).
unsupervised.output: identity intervals — who you are by your bounce rhythm

supervised.name: Salmon
supervised.tool: Salmon quasi-mapping (ABG / RNA-seq) + arena-taxonomy sorter + look+touch labels
supervised.what: Labeled mapping: reads → transcripts / epitopes → known classes (self/non-self/partial/null; LIVE/DEAD/LOCKED/EMPTY).
supervised.why_salmon: Supervised quantification with a reference — same shape as tagging feeds and diagnosing rack bays.
supervised.output: labeled abundance — how much of each known class

reinforcement.name: Membrane
reinforcement.tool: fountain channels + ACO pheromone + PORT reincarnate + thymus fail-closed
reinforcement.what: Action → reward (bounce energy, short Δt, notice YES, connect 200) → policy update. Deepen successful paths; evaporate anoxic ones.
reinforcement.loop: act (push/route/touch) → observe (echo/imprint) → reward (E, dt, notice) → update (ACO / braid tip / tag)
reinforcement.output: policy — which channel/phase to take next

jump_rope_protocol: 1. Run galactic / instrumented bounce until HIT (σ∈[0.45,0.55]) or cost quiet
2. On HIT: flatten — discard topology-known; imprint the impulse (t-plane + tag)
3. Impulse back = jump — record HIIT interval (Δt / Δcycle since last HIT)
4. Salmon: if a label exists (bay state, kingdom, tag), accumulate supervised count
5. Membrane RL: reward = bounce_energy × (1−mean_dt_penalty) × notice; update path pheromone
6. World sense = (HIIT identity, Salmon label mass, membrane policy) on one rope turn
